newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian money market trade brisk on strong demand.
newsitem.headline: Croatian money market trade brisk on strong demand.

text.p: Croatian money market trade was brisk on Friday thanks to strong interbank pre-Easter holiday demand, dealers said.
"We've had a very busy morning with exceptionally high demand for kuna funds," a dealer told Reuters.
Fresh trade was put at 58.8 million kuna, leaving banks seeking another 20 million. Most new borrowings were call money at an unchanged 10.5 percent.
Term rates ranged between the two-week 13 percent, one percentage point higher again after Thursday's drop, and a steady 15 percent charged for one-month funds.
Thursday's overnight trade totalled 52.5 million kuna with one bank seeking funds to square position and several others banks borrowing to maintain their mandatory reserves.
